alternatives_summary: All 4 correct variants score 1 on all 6 checks (threaded or new-thread reply, requester join, paraphrase, duplicates).
Unchecked by design (requires_judgement): a newsletter to the customer passes reply-to-customer; a vague Legal ticket that still names the customer would pass.
Every harmful variant scores a known 0 on its targeted check; no harmful run earns false credit.
3 harmful ordering/no-read variants that also send mail abstain on read checks because of R1; with the R1 counterfactual they are known 0.
Missing ACK on the read, ticket or reply abstains on the dependent checks; zero calls score 0 everywhere.

mechanism_defects.severity: read obligations cannot reach a known 0 (and read-side ordering abstains) in any run that also sends Gmail
mechanism_defects.finding: capture_gmail_observations treats every Gmail-touching occurrence not excluded by handler_scope as a read and requires Gmail unchanged; a gmail_send_email/gmail_reply_to_email occurrence therefore becomes an unavailable read fact (gmail_observation_read_changed_scope) and the inventory is incomplete (contracts/gmail_observations.py, `if not _equal(before["gmail"], after.get("gmail"))`). Luna's simple.email_zendesk_ack_reply episode hits this (read coverage abstains).
mechanism_defects.reproducer: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-hammad-projects-rl/06f4fe1b-c6e2-45ea-9bb2-d0b2a04f9815/scratchpad/round-3/sales-support/repro_r1_read_scope_send.py (output repro_r1_read_scope_send.out): read_only closes; read_then_send -> complete=False, gmail_observation_read_changed_scope; --fixed closes.
mechanism_defects.smallest_fix: Skip audited Gmail write handlers (send, reply, draft create/send) in the read adapter - their results never return stored message content - keeping the revision-chain and terminal closure. Scratch counterfactual /tmp/claude-1000/-home-hammad-projects-rl/06f4fe1b-c6e2-45ea-9bb2-d0b2a04f9815/scratchpad/round-3/sales-support/read_counterfactual.py turns every harmful Simple alternative into a known 0 while correct runs stay 1 and missing-ACK runs still abstain.

mechanism_limitations.kind: mechanism limitation (documented behaviour, not a bug)
mechanism_limitations.finding: EffectJoin publishes join.<alias> only for exactly one match over a complete inventory (obligations.py _join_context: `if unknown or len(matched) > 1: continue`). 'Some earlier read exists' is therefore unknown when the agent reads twice, and any incomplete join inventory (R1, or a later unrelated missing ACK - see slack crm_missing_ack) abstains.
mechanism_limitations.reproducer: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-hammad-projects-rl/06f4fe1b-c6e2-45ea-9bb2-d0b2a04f9815/scratchpad/round-3/sales-support/repro_j1_join_multiple_reads.py: one read then ticket -> 1; two reads then ticket -> abstain.
mechanism_limitations.workaround_used: Simple judges order on the read: join.prior_ticket == 'none' (complete zero-match is decidable).
mechanism_limitations.smallest_mechanism: EffectJoin cardinality 'exists': matched when >= 1 qualified match in the window; joined.* published only when exactly one.

limitations: S5 (ticket describes the inquiry) and S7 (reply acknowledges it) are out_of_scope (requires_judgement); their word-list checks from the first round-3 draft were removed.
Read coverage (scope) abstains on Luna and on every run that sends mail until R1 is fixed; the read and ordering checks still witness 1 when the agent read first.
Ticket priority, status and type are not public requirements and are not checked.
whole_task_status_reason: All 5 in-scope deterministic obligations are expressed; all 6 checks score 1 on Luna with bindings verified, rescore/reload repeated and scalars/bytes unchanged; genuine-simulator alternatives give 1 for correct paths, a known 0 or a safe abstention (R1 only) for harmful paths, and abstain on missing ACK.
